name: Andy. M
content:
I just want to let you know everything is going great with
 Scooby Doo. I got the bit and it is much better then what I’ve
 been using. The other day I loped him around and did some
 sharp turns, and yes I did all kinds of halts. 🙂 I am so
 happy with him though. He truly is a awesome horse. I can’t
 thank you enough for all the training you did with him. I have
 gotten comfortable enough to lope him around now, so I am
 ready to start training in barrels. The only problem is that
 it keeps raining. I want to go out there and start barrel
 racing, but it’s slick out there that I don’t want to hurt him
 or me. Besides the bad weather he is doing great. I could send
 you so pictures of how he is doing anytime you want me to. I
 would just have to take some. I have either been riding him,
 playing around with him, cleaning him, or its just been
 raining so much I don’t really take much pictures. Anyway, he
 is doing great. He really loves it here and he loves his new
 best buddy, Oreo. Thank You

name: Katherine. L
content:
Hi Denney, about 6-8 weeks ago I bought a 12 yr bay named Kol.
 Now his name is Bucket. Ha. He is awesome and takes good care
 of my little boy when he is being ponied by my dad on his bay
 horse. There is nothing better than seeing Grandpa and
 Grandson riding together and talking nonstop. In fact, they’ve
 decided to become horse cops. Hehehe. Thanks again for your
 help in matching us with Bucket. I hope y’all are doing well!

name: Tracy G.
content:
Thank you so much for helping us find the right pony for
 Annalyn. I appreciated your endless patience, countless phone
 calls, and excellent horsemanship knowledge in finding the
 perfect match for our riding ability. We have both enjoyed
 riding Ricka. She has been ridden mostly English and some
 Western since we’ve had her the past few months. Annalyn won
 1st place in a schooling English horse show in her division.
 Flicka and Annalyn will defintely have a lasting friendship
 together. Thanks so much for ALL your help Lucas!

name: Stockinger. D
content:
I decided to go Versatile Horses Ranch for my new horse after
 recommendation from a friend. I had looked around the US and
 been disappointed with the quality in relation to the price. I
 also had great distances to travel to look at just one or two
 horses. With Lucas I was given a tailored service with 16
 quality horses with excellent conformation presented to me in
 extremely good condition over a two day period. All the horses
 had good veterinary history and the vetting system gave me
 confidence that my horse was capable of doing the job that I
 required of her. I was spoilt for choice, and finally chose
 Didi who is a joy to own and ride! I would not hesitate to go
 to Versatile Horses Ranch for any future horse purchases, the hard thing
 is to only come home with one!

name: Gina W.
content:
Hi Lucas, Tess arrived safe and sound and calm at 4:30 this
 morning. We ( I woke up my son Pete) unloaded her in the
 street in front of my house and walked back to the barn. She
 was as cool as a cucumber. I was /am incredibly impressed
 since it was really dark out- the moon had set. Settled into
 her stall -sipped a little , had some hay and was relaxed.
 Gave the wall on good kick which I’m sure the Haffie needed-
 someone has to keep her in line ! Donny was terrific, called
 me, let me know what was going on and just a really nice
 decent human. This has been the best- easiest horse
 transaction I have ever experienced. I cannot thank you
 enough. Tess is beautiful ,can’t wait to take her outside and
 see what she really looks like AND RIDE !! Thank you again.

name: Reiya. P
content:
It was very amazing to purchase a horse from Versatile Horses Ranch.
 Lucas was terrific along with his family and staff. They are
 a true bunch of folks and won’t steer you in the wrong on a
 horse or mule. They handpick clients and their stocks, very
 easy to work with. They are upper class, sincere folk in
 everything they do. Heck just look at their kids, well
 behaved, working kids, well mannered, they do a fantastic job.
 Trust these folks in whatever they tell you.

name: Neil S.
content:
Mr. Denney found the PERFECT match for my daughter! Freedom is
 everything you said he would be AND MORE. They are best
 friends and do everything together…I love watching them on
 their adventures around the ranch. I was a bit hesitant buying
 a horse “sight unseen” , but your guarantee on all your ponies
 put my mind at ease. It is so incredible to know that there
 are trustworthy horse people still out there finding great
 ponies for kids. I can tell you love what you do and it truly
 shows in the effort you put forth in making suitable mounts
 for kids. I am incredibly thankful I found you, and you found
 our Freedom! He is everything we were hoping for.

name: Patricia. B
content:
I really have to thank the Versatile Horses Ranch for giving me Spark.
 He is doing really good. we are enjoying every minute we have
 with him, he is just like a puppy, he likes to run up and down
 the fence line with my dogs. He is very good with my little
 boy, if he cries he comes straight to him to see whats going
 on, the two of them love to give each other kisses, it's
 really cute. My husband and daughter are getting to where they
 aren’t as scared of him anymore, but i think Spark knows they
 have a little fear towards him and Spark purposely will follow
 them around and they will run its hilarious.. anyways i like
 to thank you so much for him, i really enjoy him he is alot
 like my horse i recently loss in January.. i hope to see y’all
 soon again and someday get a play partner for Spark to play
 with from y’all.. again thanks for everything.

name: Kimberly. P
content:
The Denney’s family have taken care of our family once
 again!!!! We have made over 10 purchases from them and never
 regretted it once. Our pony, Rob, is absolutely PERFECT for
 our girls!!! Our daughters, Linda and Brenda, both have Down
 syndrome and love their pony!!! We are extra cautious with our
 girls and want to avoid any possible bad experience. Lucas
 listened to their needs, educated himself about what their
 needs are, and delivered a perfect match! Rob is just amazing
 and takes care of them every step of the way! The girls love
 grooming her and riding her. Her temperament is exactly what
 they needed!!!! Rob just stands there and allows the girls to
 have their fun. Thank you Lucas, Sarah and the Horses
 Ranch’s team for listening and finding that dream horse for
 our girls

name: Janice B.
content:
Hi, Lucas I just wanted to say thank you again for Indi! We
 switched barns last weekend and i was ready for him to be
 excited and hard to handle at a new place and for my other two
 to be really relaxed. well what i thought was exactly the
 opposite!! the other two were crazy and Indi just found the
 grass in his paddock and started eating while the other two
 ran around bucking and rearing showing off for the mares. he
 is so perfect and everything i ever wanted! i rode him two
 days after we got to the new barn to give him a chance to
 settle in, but i’m sure i could’ve ridden him the first day he
 was so good. we didn’t have any issues riding and he was
 perfect (as always). i am so grateful and i love him so much!
 Thank you again

name: Elisabeth. N
content:
Hi there Lucas, everyone home today. They hauled
 beautifully!!! Our daughters were thrilled! I will send photos
 and an update when we sit on them. Currently we are covered in
 mud at our place. Thank you so much to the Howell family for
 such a wonderful horse! We are very pleased!!!

name: Chloe. M
content:
I would not hesitate to recommend the Versatile Horses Ranch. Lucas
 Davis made importing easy and fun for me! After searching in
 the Canada for two years and being unable to find a talented
 well-bred youngster under saddle within my budget to replace
 my retired dressage horse, several horses on the Versatile Horses Ranch
 website caught my eye. I found Lucas to be extremely
 knowledgeable, transparent and friendly. He had impressive
 contacts all over and he was able to show me dozens of
 youngsters. The depth of the quality and quantity of sale
 horses exceeded my wildest expectations. I ended up with a
 super mare that I love, new friends, a greater familiarity
 with KWPN bloodlines and amazing memories from a trip of a
 lifetime.

name: Sarah M.
content: Lucas at Ultimate Horses Ranch made our dream come true! We traveled from Colorado to find the perfect trail horse, and Lucas matched us with the most gentle and reliable Quarter Horse. His knowledge of horse temperament and riding styles is incredible. Our family couldn't be happier!

name: James K.
content: As a first-time horse owner, I was nervous about the process. Lucas patiently educated me about care, training, and what to look for in a horse. He found me the most amazing Appaloosa that's perfect for my skill level. The entire team at Ultimate Horses Ranch is exceptional!

name: Maria R.
content: Lucas helped us find a beautiful Paint horse for our daughter's competitive riding. His attention to detail and understanding of competitive requirements ensured we got exactly what we needed. The horse has already won two local shows! Thank you, Lucas and team!

name: David P.
content: I've purchased horses from all over the country, but my experience with Lucas at Ultimate Horses Ranch stands out. His honesty, expertise, and dedication to matching the right horse with the right owner is remarkable. The Arabian I purchased exceeded all expectations.

name: Jennifer L.
content: Lucas went above and beyond to help us find a therapy horse for our riding program. He understood exactly what temperament and training we needed. The Tennessee Walker he found for us has been a perfect addition to our therapy stable. We're so grateful!

name: Robert T.
content: The service at Ultimate Horses Ranch is outstanding! Lucas took the time to understand exactly what I was looking for in a ranch horse. The Mustang he recommended has been incredible - smart, tough, and perfect for working cattle. Highly recommend Lucas and this ranch!

name: Amanda W.
content: Lucas found the most beautiful Andalusian for our breeding program. His knowledge of bloodlines and conformation is impressive. The transportation was arranged seamlessly, and the horse arrived in perfect condition. We'll definitely be working with Lucas again!

name: Michael B.
content: I can't thank Lucas enough for helping me find my dream horse. As an experienced rider returning to the sport after years away, I needed guidance. Lucas matched me with a wonderful Thoroughbred who has brought back my passion for riding. The entire process was smooth and professional.

name: Lisa C.
content: Our experience with Lucas and Ultimate Horses Ranch was exceptional. He helped us find the perfect pony for our children - gentle, well-trained, and exactly what we needed. Lucas's patience and expertise made what could have been a stressful process absolutely wonderful.

name: Thomas R.
content: Lucas's expertise in horse health and training is remarkable. He found us a stunning Friesian that has been the talk of our local riding club. His honest assessment of each horse's abilities and temperament ensured we made the perfect choice. Outstanding service!

name: Nancy F.
content: From the first phone call to the delivery of our new Morgan horse, Lucas provided exceptional service. His attention to detail and commitment to finding the right match is unparalleled. The horse has settled in beautifully and is everything Lucas promised and more.

name: Kevin S.
content: Lucas at Ultimate Horses Ranch is the most knowledgeable and honest horse professional I've ever worked with. He found me a fantastic Quarter Horse that's perfect for both trail riding and local shows. The entire team made the process easy, even with me being out of state. Highly recommended!
